briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race to deploy agentic systems as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier intensifies with multiple labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Agentic workflows dominate deployments while regulatory scrutiny grows in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4-preview demonstrates multi-step planning gains. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro compete on long-context tasks. Meta open-sources Llama 4 while DeepSeek-V3 undercuts pricing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to xAI and Microsoft. TSMC reports 3nm yields improving for custom ASICs. New data center builds announced in Texas and Saudi Arabia.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems by Q2 2027?
